title: Fleet occupancy stitch — daily 2026-06-21
body:
Context:
This is a stitch-style snapshot of the GPU occupancy dashboard for 2026-06-21 (UTC). Generated from the dashboard export pipeline (stitch job id: stitch-2026-06-21-07). Purpose: daily quick view for on-call and capacity planners; highlights cluster/pool hotspots and daypart patterns for the last 24h window.

Notes-to-self / quick summary:
- Fleet total GPUs: 12,720 (hosts pooled across NA/EU/APAC).
- Weighted average GPU utilization (token-time weighted): 58.3%.
- Peak 5m window (UTC 15:25): 92.5% cluster-level utilization in cluster-az1-eu-1-poolA.
- Sustained (>60m) high-util clusters: cluster-na-west-2-poolX, cluster-az1-eu-1-poolA.
- Low-util pools (avg < 15%): pool-test-isolated, pool-dev-shortjobs — candidates for consolidation.
- Notable microburst: APAC pool apac-gpu-burst saw 4x baseline at 2026-06-21T03:12Z for ~12 minutes; burst correlated with regen job from tenant corp-analytics (ticket INF-4320).

Raw stitch rows (sample, columns = timestamp, region, cluster, pool, gpus_online, avg_util_pct, p95_latency_ms, queued_tasks):
2026-06-21T00:00Z, NA, cluster-na-east-1, pool-reserved-1, 320, 47.1, 11.2, 12
2026-06-21T00:00Z, EU, cluster-az1-eu-1, poolA, 256, 65.9, 14.7, 34
2026-06-21T00:00Z, APAC, cluster-ap-sg1, pool-burst, 128, 22.3, 9.8, 4
2026-06-21T15:25Z, EU, cluster-az1-eu-1, poolA, 256, 92.5, 29.6, 86
2026-06-21T03:12Z, APAC, cluster-ap-sg1, pool-burst, 128, 88.1, 42.0, 192

Derived signals / automated flags (from stitch rules):
- flag_high_sustained_util: cluster-az1-eu-1-poolA triggered (sustained > 85% for 75m) — severity: amber.
- flag_microburst: apac-gpu-burst — severity: yellow, repeat events last 7 days: 3.
- flag_fragmentation: cluster-na-west-2-poolX — many small slices (avg slot size 2 GPUs) causing fragmentation despite spare headroom.

Operational impact notes:
- The EU canary for model-s-realtime experienced degraded P95 at 15:25 UTC; automatic fallback to model-s-lt occurred but add 6% cost overhead. Logged in INF-4317.
- APAC microburst briefly backpressured Dedicated burst capacity; some latency-sensitive tenants saw 2x p95 for ~10m. No complete timeouts.
- Test/dev pools account for ~8% of total capacity but <2% utilization; recommend reclaim script to consolidate into dev-shared for cost savings.

Actionable recommendations (short-term):
1) Rebalance candidate: shift 40 GPUs from pool-dev-shortjobs -> pool-reserved-1 in NA to smooth fragmentation (owner: Marco, due: 2026-06-24).
2) Canary scaling policy tweak: increase EU canary fallback threshold from 80% -> 85% for poolA to reduce oscillation; monitor for 72h (owner: Sana, PR: infra#782).
3) Investigate tenant regens: open surveillance on tenant corp-analytics schedule and request rate throttling (owner: Liam, ticket INF-4320).
4) Consolidation runbook: dry-run reclaim script against pool-test-isolated on 2026-06-25; report headroom delta (owner: Aisha).

Capacity planning signals (weekly lookahead):
- Rolling 7d growth in inbound requests (token-reqs) for NA: +11% vs baseline; if trend continues, plan +400 GPUs reserved in NA for Q3 (proposal draft linked).
- EU demand appears flat but heavy tail events concentrated in poolA; consider short-term burst reservation for peak windows (18:00-17:00 UTC).
- APAC shows higher variance; recommend keeping 10% burst buffer and reviewing autoscale cooldowns.

Investigations / follow-ups in this doc:
- fragmentation-debug: attach slot distribution histogram for cluster-na-west-2 (to be exported) — blocked on telemetry aggregation (infra-telemetry team).
- microburst-correlation: correlate job ids for 2026-06-21T03:00-03:30Z in apac with job-manager logs (Sana).

Quick heuristics for on-call (copied to runbook):
- If any cluster sustains >90% for >15m AND queued_tasks > 50, escalate to infra on-call and open incident stub.
- If p95 latency crosses 2x baseline for >10m, trigger automatic fallback for affected route and notify product channel.

Attachments / derived files (not embedded in this JSON):
- stitch-csv: s3://stitch-exports/2026-06-21/fleet-occupancy-stitch.csv
- histograms: s3://stitch-exports/2026-06-21/cluster-na-west-2-slot-histo.png
- query used: SELECT timestamp, region, cluster, pool, gpus_online, avg_util_pct, p95_latency_ms, queued_tasks FROM stitch_view WHERE date = '2026-06-21'

Open questions / unknowns:
- What changed in cluster-az1-eu-1 config between 2026-06-18 and 2026-06-21 — there was a small kernel-level driver update on 2026-06-19 (PR #749). Could driver change impact packing/latency?
- Are preemption/backfill windows for reserved pools correctly tuned for evening EU traffic spikes? Need SRE confirmation.

Local scratch / TODOs:
- Run consolidation simulation (Aisha) — expected freed GPUs: ~28 if pool-test-isolated is reclaimed; run simulation by 2026-06-23.
- Generate per-tenant impact matrix for cluster-az1-eu-1 for last 7 days (Liam).

If anything critical shows up overnight, ping infra-ops and append incidents here. This doc is intentionally a working export — use as a provenance artifact for daily capacity standup.

-- end of stitch snapshot (generated 2026-06-22T02:18Z)
